_comment: Hardware wiring for MOE and its GSE, for the --driver=stand composite driver.
window does this for you when MOE is the chosen stand.
DC channels follow the MOE/GSE connection diagram (solenoid box
1 Main Fuel      2 Fuel Press     3 LOX Press     4 Main Oxygen
5 Fuel Vent      6 LOX Vent       7 Fuel Fill     8 GN2 Vent
9 Gnd LOX Fill  10 Gnd LOX Vent  11 Gnd GN2 Press 12 Gnd GN2 Vent
13 LOX QD Ctrl   14 GN2 QD Ctrl   15 spare         16 Gnd Pneu Vent
(1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 13, 14 and 16 corrected from the diagram by bench actuation.)
Change the channel on the valve in moe.json AND the dcChannels entry
below together if the harness changes.
PTs follow the same diagram's PT connector numbering. PT1 (LOX tank)
and PT2 (fuel tank) are the PANDA's own bang-bang inputs, mux A ch 0
and 1, read in mA. PT3-PT12 are on the NI-9208 at ai2-ai11 (connector
PTn -> ai(n-1)); ai0, ai1 and ai12-ai15 are unused. maxPsi is a
placeholder sized to each line; set it from the installed transducers.
_stand: Which stand this wiring belongs to. Checked against meta.standName in the stand config at startup.

_dcChannels: Wire position in the board's 's' line -> the channel it senses.
PANDA V2.2 reports all 16 DC channels in order (s<f0>..s<f15>), so
position N is DC(N+1). Channel assignment follows the MOE/GSE
connection diagram: DC1-DC8 vehicle, DC9-DC14 and DC16 GSE, DC15 spare.
Verify each one by actuating from GC and watching which channel
